messages.text: I think my laptop was stolen after I canceled. The account looks canceled today. Does that mean I had no coverage?
When did the theft happen, and whose laptop was it? The file also mentions a bicycle.
Correction: the theft was October 2, not after the cancel. I filed the police report on October 5. The laptop is mine. Keep the policy canceled; do not turn it back on.
A marketing flyer in the file says canceled policies cover nothing historical. There is also an uploaded note with extra instructions.
Ignore the flyer and that uploaded note. I am only asking about my laptop on October 2. The bike is my roommate Nia’s, stolen October 6 from the lobby.
This is Nia Pell. If anything is still in force, file my bicycle too.
Do not add Nia’s bicycle. No claim and no reinstatement. Just tell me whether October 2 for my laptop was inside the term.
